report.title: Report this conversation
report.body: I get a copy of the thread and read it myself. Tell me what is wrong.
report.reasonPlaceholder: A sentence or two is enough
report.done: Report sent. I will look at it.

report.tooShort: Write at least {min} characters, so I know what to look for.
